**Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd. (M&M) Brief**  
*Data as of 10–11 Jun 2026*

### Operating Performance
May 2026 volumes reached 99,636 autos (+20% YoY), including 58,021 domestic SUVs, and 49,695 tractors (+22% YoY). Farm Equipment tractor sales alone rose 23% YoY to 47,845 units, supporting resilient rural demand. [10][41]

### Financial Performance
FY25 PAT was ₹12,929 cr (+20% YoY), with Q4 FY25 PAT at ₹3,295 cr (+20% YoY). FY26 PAT grew 35%. TTM figures show revenue ₹2.0208 T, net income ₹171 B and FCF ₹156.6 B. TTM margins were gross 39.173%, operating 16.398% and net 8.461%, with ROE at 18.754%. [15][16][12]

### Balance Sheet & Capital Structure (TTM)
Debt/equity stood at 1.25066 and current ratio at 1.27. Shares outstanding are reported as 1.2435 B or ~1.11 B; the difference is unresolved in available filings. [12][20][21]

### Valuation (close 10 Jun 2026)
Price was ₹2,952.5, market cap ₹3.603 T. TTM P/E 19.74, forward P/E 18.76, PEG 1.26; P/B 3.60, P/S 1.78, EV/EBITDA 10.50. EPS (TTM) ₹152.05 and dividend yield 1.12% (₹33/share). 52-week range ₹2,896–3,839.9. [11][12]

### Competitive Position
M&M held 43.6% share of the Indian tractor market in FY26 (+30 bps YoY), with YTD FY26 share at 44.1% (May 2026). SUV revenue share strengthened +90 bps YoY through June 2026. [4][5][20]

### Outlook & Catalysts
Nomura forecasts FY27 UV volume growth of 14% (753–851k units) and tractor volume growth of 5% (526–552k units). Rural demand, premiumisation and exports remain the three primary FY27 growth pillars for the Indian auto sector. [4][9][20]

### Risks & Macro Factors
A sub-par 2026 monsoon is flagged as a potential headwind to rural incomes and volumes. No quantified exposures to FAME-III, PLI-auto, BS-VII or EV-mandate risks appear in June 2026 filings or presentations. FY27 India GDP growth is projected at 6.6% (BMI, as-of 11 Jun 2026); M&M-specific volume elasticity figures are not available. [4][7][new findings]

**Data Gaps**  
Full P&L splits (Auto vs Farm), net debt, capex, working-capital trends and FY26–28 consensus EPS not located in exchange filings or contemporaneous sources. No FY26 SUV/LCV market-share figures or peer comparisons (e.g., John Deere) are reported. [12][13][15][16][18]
